guard_verification.interpretation: The guard demonstrably catches explicit 每年每席位 and generated one verification event covering three price issues. limits: Correct exact quotations do not establish statement entailment or correct pricing units.

The42 price claims marked within scope were inspected for amounts/currency/month-vs-year/billing/tax/enterprise boundary; this is not a claim about every sentence, external market truth or general model performance.
SSO audit does not certify all narrative sections; it specifically inspected SSO facts in claim fields including other dimensions.
No paid calls, ledger access, report rewrite or fixture/gold/code edits were performed. Existing failures are retained.
